verdict.rationale: Postman collections/environments are JSON-based and can technically be exported (postman-docs-5, postman-comm-14 quoting Postman's own former 'complete control over your data' goal), but extensive community evidence describes forced cloud account requirements, data/collections wiped when declining login, telemetry uploading secrets, and strong lock-in pushing users toward per-seat cloud subscriptions to share or migrate data (postman-comm-2, -4, -6, -12, -13, -15, -16, -17).
